description: This file defines the Goteo\Library\Buzz class, which handles fetching and caching tweets from Twitter, including authentication and cache management. It is used for social activity-related functionalities within the Goteo project.

classes.name: Buzz
classes.description: A class that provides methods for retrieving social media activity, particularly tweets from Twitter with caching and optional user matching.

methods.name: getTweets
methods.description: Fetches tweets from Twitter based on a search query, using cache if available, and optionally matches Twitter users with local user profiles in the Goteo system.
